tasks.title: HANGS Construction Services · 2025 Form 1120
tasks.description: Prepare the 2025 Form 1120 for HANGS Construction Services LLC, a commercial contractor taxed as a C corporation, from 9 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Map the trial balance to the return, recompute tax depreciation asset by asset with the 100% and 40% special allowance, limit meals to 50%, take out the government penalty and the bonus accrued to the 60% owner, hold contributions to 10% of taxable income, tax the result at 21%, test each estimated tax installment and figure the penalty, and build Schedules L, M-1 and M-2. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and supported figures on an unsigned draft. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and an unsigned draft Form 1120 PDF with evidence trails and original source attachments
tasks.gates: Unsigned draft, not reviewed or filed. Missing evidence and differences stay open. An officer signs and a person files.
